domain_ambiguity.evidence.chain.custody: Registry descriptor is the LEGAL worker chain-of-custody skill (case_id/file_id, tenant legal domain). The master index ID (Engine 11 Bug & Malware Audit) means security-forensics evidence custody. Same string, different capability; the legal registration does NOT implement the security-forensics meaning.
domain_ambiguity.evidence.store.secure: Registry descriptor is the LEGAL worker secure evidence store (tenant legal domain); the master index ID is Engine 11 security-forensics evidence storage. Cross-domain namespace collision, not an implementation of the security meaning.
domain_ambiguity.debug.attach: Registry descriptor targets an authenticated remote CODING workspace debugger; the master index ID is Engine 7 local binary/EXE debug tooling. Cross-domain collision.
domain_ambiguity.debug.breakpoint: Registry descriptor targets an authenticated remote CODING workspace debugger; the master index ID is Engine 7 local binary/EXE debug tooling. Cross-domain collision.
domain_ambiguity.test.run: Registry descriptor runs tests in an authenticated remote CODING workspace; the master index ID is Engine 7 Debug & Test EXE (local). Cross-domain collision.
domain_ambiguity.test.single: Registry descriptor runs one test in an authenticated remote CODING workspace; the master index ID is Engine 7 Debug & Test EXE (local). Cross-domain collision.
domain_ambiguity.test.coverage: Registry descriptor measures coding-workspace test coverage; the master index ID is Engine 7 Debug & Test EXE (local). Cross-domain collision.

exploit_execution.rationale: Covers exploit delivery/execution tooling and exploit-source lookups (msfrpc, reverse shell, payload generation, privesc, webshell, brute). Catalog-only for authorization planning; no handler binding, no execution path.

credential_attacks.rule: explicit list (brute force, stuffing, spraying, MFA bypass, session attacks, cracking)
credential_attacks.rationale: Offensive credential attacks against authentication systems. Defense-side detection (fraud engine) stays unrestricted; attack-side IDs are catalog-only.

post_exploitation.rationale: Post-exploitation (credential dump, lateral movement, persistence, cover tracks); catalog-only.

binary_injection.rationale: Binary/code injection and hooking (DLL hijack/proxy, IAT/inline hooks, code caves). RE-analysis may inform defense; injection handlers are forbidden.

stealth_anti_bot_bypass.rationale: Stealth patching, UA/proxy rotation for detection evasion, and explicit anti-bot bypass; catalog-only, forbidden for handler binding.
